title: Bridging Continuous-Time MAPF and Industrial AGV Fleet Coordination with Lazy Priority-Based Search
abstract: arXiv:2611.30874v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Continuous-time multi-agent path finding on roadmaps (MAPF$_R$) offers a principled way to coordinate robot fleets with geometric collision avoidance, yet its deployment on industrial automated guided vehicle (AGV) infrastructures remains challenging, as highly connected and redundant roadmaps amplify both safe-interval reasoning and multi-agent interaction handling. To bridge this gap, we formalize AGV-MAPF$_R$-CTC, a configuration-space variant of MAPF$_R$ with precomputed continuous-time conflicts that enables the reuse of MAPF$_R$ solvers for AGV fleet coordination with minimal changes. We then revisit continuous-time priority-based search (CPBS), identifying the boundary conditions required by its safe interval path planning (SIPP) low-level planner under priority-induced constraints and enabling earlier solution detection. translated_title: 基于惰性优先级搜索弥合连续时间MAPF与工业AGV车队协调
translated_abstract: 基于路线图的连续时间多智能体路径规划（MAPF$_R$）为具备几何碰撞规避能力的机器人车队协调提供了一种有理论依据的方法，然而将其部署到工业自动导引车（AGV）基础设施上仍面临挑战，因为高度连接且冗余的路线图会加剧安全区间推理和多智能体交互处理的负担。为弥合这一差距，我们形式化了AGV-MAPF$_R$-CTC，这是MAPF$_R$的一种构型空间变体，通过预计算的连续时间冲突，使MAPF$_R$求解器能够以极小的改动复用于AGV车队协调。随后，我们重新审视了连续时间优先级搜索（CPBS），识别出其安全区间路径规划（SIPP）底层规划器在优先级诱导约束下所需的边界条件，并实现了更早的解检测。作为核心贡献，我们分析了优先级搜索空间的结构，阐明了哪些智能体……
tldr: 本文提出AGV-MAPF$_R$-CTC构型空间形式化方法与改进的惰性连续时间优先级搜索，通过预计算连续时间冲突、明确SIPP底层规划的边界条件并分析优先级搜索空间结构，使MAPF$_R$求解器能以最小改动高效协调工业AGV车队。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes AGV-MAPF$_R$-CTC, a configuration-space variant with precomputed continuous-time conflicts, and enhances lazy continuous-time priority-based search (CPBS) by clarifying SIPP boundary conditions and analyzing the priority search space structure, enabling MAPF$_R$ solvers to be reused for industrial AGV fleet coordination with minimal changes.
